steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Configure project build parameters and SDK version limits to compile against Android SDK 34.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Declare required permissions including CAMERA, hardware features, and launch Activities in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Application Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json to lock down app names and package details.

steps.title: Design UI Layout
steps.description: Design layout with a Camera Preview container, animated scanner indicator, scanned text editor, and Speak controls.

steps.title: Setup Runtime Permissions Handler
steps.description: Write code in MainActivity to request CAMERA permission dynamically and handle grant states gracefully.

steps.title: Configure Camera Surface View Holder
steps.description: Implement SurfaceHolder callbacks to initialize, start, and stop the camera hardware preview session.

steps.title: Integrate Text To Speech Engine
steps.description: Initialize Android's built-in TextToSpeech framework with support for volume, speed rate, and pitch factors.

steps.title: Implement Scan OCR Simulation Logic
steps.description: Create smart mockup scan OCR capabilities executing safe photo frame processing and returning context-aware texts.

steps.title: Add Pitch & Speed Slider Handlers
steps.description: Set listener logic on pitch and speed seekbars to update TTS parameters dynamically prior to speaking.

steps.title: Integrate System Copy Feature
steps.description: Provide clear copy-to-clipboard button allowing users to easily use simulated extracted text in other apps.

steps.title: Memory Leak Prevention
steps.description: Release camera resource locks and stop TextToSpeech engines properly within the onDestroy lifecycle callback.

steps.title: Building Scan Speak
steps.description: Compile, assemble, and package the project using standard Gradle 8.5 command structures.
